name: FormCAD
title: 2D drafting, parametric parts and NURBS surfaces on your own machine
summary: FormCAD is the CAD studio of the Form family: 2D drafting, parametric parts, NURBS surfaces and automation on an OpenCascade engine, with no account. Agents drive it over MCP.
lede: FormCAD is the CAD studio of the Form family. It combines 2D drafting, parametric parts with a feature tree, NURBS surfaces and automation on an OpenCascade engine, on your own computer with no account. The window, the command line and an MCP server all call the same 727 commands, so agents can drive it. It saves its own .fcad projects.
checks: Drafts in 2D with every drawing command, layers, layouts, blocks and plotting to PDF, PNG and SVG in one project file.
Models parametric parts with a feature tree and rollback on an OpenCascade kernel, with references that survive edits.
Blends and matches NURBS surfaces to G2, then checks the seams with zebra, curvature and deviation analysis.
Runs the same 727 commands from the window, the command line and an MCP server.

facts.dd: .fcad; interchange in DXF, SVG, STEP, IGES, 3DM, STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF and GLB
Python and FastAPI engine, vanilla TypeScript and Vite interface with three.js and a WebGL2 drafting canvas, Tauri 2 desktop shell
A separate OpenCascade 8 worker speaking JSON lines on stdio, so the app itself stays Apache-2.0
727 commands in one registry, shared by the window, the CLI and the MCP server

chapters.title: A feature tree you can edit and roll back
chapters.text: Open any feature, change its radius or depth, and the rest of the part rebuilds. A failed feature is marked with its reason and never silently changes the model.

chapters.title: Sheets that follow the model
chapters.text: Place base, projected, section and detail views in first or third angle on a layout. Views update when the part changes.

chapters.title: Surfaces checked at the seams
chapters.text: Loft, sweep, blend and match surfaces, then read continuity at the seams with zebra, curvature, draft and deviation.

requirements: Rust only for the desktop shell
docs.agents: ./formCAD mcp runs the MCP server on stdio for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Agent rules are in AGENTS.md, and two skill packs live in skills/: formcad-harness and formcad-driving.

topics.title: Run it from source
topics.text: ./formCAD serves the web UI at http://localhost:5290; ./formCAD install-kernel installs the OpenCascade worker, needed for 3D.

topics.title: Services
topics.text: The frontend is on 127.0.0.1:5290 (strict port), the preview on 5291 and the FastAPI engine on 8290, loopback only.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: Set FORMCAD_DATA_DIR, FORMCAD_PORT or FORMCAD_KERNEL in the shell to move the data folder, the engine port or the kernel worker.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: Pre-release: all 43 planned phases have landed, many as first versions. Linux builds are tested; macOS and Windows builds are configured but untested.
